name: bff-items
label: Items: columns, steps or rows
description: A list of short items shown as three columns, as three coloured steps, or as rows with the title beside the text.

items.text: Our care is collaborative, trust-based, trauma-informed and built on choice. The individual determines the destination.
items.title: Person first

items.text: We don’t decide that everyone needs treatment first, housing first, employment first or sobriety first. We ask: what does success look like to you, and what would it take to make that happen?
items.title: Wellness first

items.text: We don’t duplicate the larger system of care. We extend its reach. We work alongside existing providers and care teams so people can get services they might otherwise never reach.
items.title: The engagement bridge
